summary.text: Zenobia Merced-Bonilla, a Conservative Party district leader in the Bronx according to a Bronx.com report, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 87 to Karines Reyes.
Ballotpedia lists no prior elected office for her.

paragraphs.text: Zenobia Merced-Bonilla ran for New York City Council District 18 on the Conservative Party line in the November 4, 2025 general election, finishing third behind incumbent Amanda Farias (D/WFP) and Shuvonkar Saha (R) with 582 votes (2.1%).

A Bronx.com report published January 31, 2026 described her as a district leader in the Bronx Conservative Party and said the party had endorsed her for a different seat, New York State Senate District 34, before she appeared on the ballot for this Assembly seat.
In the November 3, 2026 general election, Merced-Bonilla lost to Karines Reyes, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.
